about: Which of the game's rendered songs and effects the web demo and the engine (engine/, marked engine/) use, and why. Facts only; the audio itself is rendered from the ROM by tools/render_audio.py and encoded by tools/export_web.py.

music.why: docs/emulation.md: the hole of course 1 requests $89 through sub_spc_play_song, id = $7E + n, so song 11. Loop points come from build/spc/wav/index.tsv.

sfx.1: bounce, fast ($81:9BE5: leaves the ground at vz >= $0500)
sfx.3: bounce, soft; also the confirm blip of the aim stage
sfx.5: the first bounce of a fly shot with spin, weak ($81:9BF4: the spin streak's sound, $68F0 - 1 + 5; spin table $84:89D0); engine/
sfx.11: a life is spent: the refill after a lost ball or no tomatoes ($80:F8D0, $80:F87C); engine/
sfx.12: an arrow panel ($14-$17) turns the ball ($82:A7D6: $6A6C = $0C, played by the step's tail); engine/
sfx.16: ball lost: a tomato is taken ($83:AC18)
sfx.17: a snap tile catches the ball ($82:A608); engine/
sfx.25: launch at full power, meter 63 ($82:BFF0 -> $82:C00B); engine/
sfx.26: a friction tile the ball rolls onto ($82:8F95); engine/
sfx.28: the last enemy turns into the cup ($82:8D49)
sfx.29: the ball rises out of the cup before it turns into the star ($84:AAC1)
sfx.33: ball holed ($81:80A5), two frames after $DA4A is set
sfx.47: Kirby lands on the tee in the hole intro ($84:B7F0)
sfx.52: the aim is confirmed with A ($81:A791 -> $80:B542; read 2026-11-14 — the turn tick is $53, $81:A988)
sfx.62: HOLE IN ONE fireworks, three bursts ($84:BCF0)
sfx.66: the top/back selector passes 6 ($81:C19F -> $81:C1A7; the side selector's tick is $46, $81:C16C)
sfx.80: an enemy with a copy ability is taken ($82:8A79); engine/
sfx.82: a tomato is gained ($83:AC07, the HUD's queue); engine/
sfx.83: the aim turns, one tick per guide recomputation ($81:A98B); engine/
sfx.84: the ball is lost ($80:F848, BallLost + 33); engine/
sfx.87: the power meter starts (the Power stage's t = 4; stopped by request 0 at $81:C038); engine/
sfx.95: the ball lands on rough ($04, $82:8EFB: $5F); engine/
sfx.96: the ball lands on rough hard, vz below -$0400 ($82:8EFB: $5F + 1; also $82:8F44); engine/
sfx.98: Kirby jumps off the warp star in the hole intro ($84:B90D)
sfx.100: the warp star flies in, hole intro ($84:B8F9)
sfx.103: the star flies up with Kirby after a hole-out ($84:A917)
sfx.111: a bumper or a hazard tile bounces the ball ($82:9C9D, $82:A5A3); engine/
sfx.113: the ball hits a pillar ($82:956C, $82:95F8); engine/
sfx.119: object $40 after the out-of-tomatoes sleep ($80:F89E); engine/
sfx.123: a volcano throws the ball ($82:DB9A code $0F); engine/
sfx.124: the ball touches a volcano's cone (the cone handler in engine/src/core/sim/hazards.ts); engine/

songs.17: Kirby falls asleep, out of tomatoes (request $8F, the OutOfTomatoes path after $82:E1EE; also the fall in ball mode 10); engine/
songs.18: the ball falls off the course (request $90, $81:A16C-$81:A190); engine/
songs.24: the star exit after a hole-out: requested from $83:C748 (A = $96) as the cup's ball rises, in both hole-out paths (tools/snesstep/trace_cutscene.py)
songs.25: hole-out jingle: $83:D2B6 (A = $97) when the shot counter $7E:D82A is not 2, i.e. not a hole in one. (An earlier guess had song 17 here; it is not requested in a hole-out.)
songs.26: HOLE IN ONE fanfare: $83:D2DD (A = $98) after song 0 stops the music at $83:D2C9, when $7E:D82A = 2
